overall_assessment: Extraction quality for nord is moderate: the descriptive sections (course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods) are usually clean and correctly labelled, but the assessment-cluster is systematically broken. Every reviewed course concatenates arbeidskrav/obligatorisk deltakelse (coursework requirements, 0/100) together with the graded exam under a single `assessment` row, and no `coursework_requirements` section is ever emitted. The `prerequisites` row is almost always admission/study-right boilerplate rather than subject-matter prior knowledge.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk deltakelse - minimum 80%, teller 0/100 av karakteren ... Arbeidskrav, 3 arbeider, teller 0/100 av karakteren
findings.description: No course in the sample emits a `coursework_requirements` row at all, even though nearly every Nord plan contains explicit arbeidskrav (AK) and obligatorisk deltakelse (OD) that count 0/100 of the grade and only gate access to the exam. Per the codebook these belong in coursework_requirements, so this canonical section is universally absent.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Heading map / splitter: Nord places AK + OD + exam under one combined 'Vurdering/Eksamen'-style block, and the rule-based splitter assigns the whole block to assessment with no rule that carves out arbeidskrav/obligatorisk-deltakelse into a separate section.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a post-split rule: within the assessment block, move lines/paragraphs matching ^(Arbeidskrav|Arbeidskrav \(AK\)|AK:|Obligatorisk deltak(else|ing)|Obligatorisk deltagelse|OD:|OD\b) (and their following description until the next component) into coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk deltagelse (OD): ... Må være godkjent for å kunne gå opp til eksamen. Arbeidskrav (AK): 3-6 arbeidskrav som alle må være ... godkjent for å få gå opp til eksamen. Hjemmeeksamen (HJ): ...
findings.description: The `assessment` row mixes graded exam components with arbeidskrav/obligatorisk-deltakelse gates (explicitly 0/100, godkjent/ikke godkjent, 'må være godkjent før eksamen'). Per the codebook's most-important distinction, only the graded exam belongs in assessment; the gating items are coursework_requirements. This is the same defect as the missing section above, viewed from the assessment side: assessment is polluted with non-assessment text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Same combined Nord vurdering block routed wholesale to assessment; the splitter does not separate pass/fail gates from graded components.
findings.suggested_fix: After the carve-out rule above runs, the residual assessment row should retain only the graded component(s) (lines with 'teller 100/100', 'A-F', 'Karakterskala', 'Skriftlig skoleeksamen', 'Hjemmeeksamen', 'Mappe ... teller', 'Praktisk gruppeeksamen'). Validate by checking that no remaining assessment line contains 'teller 0/100' or 'må være godkjent ... eksamen'.

findings.evidence: Ingen utover opptakskravet. / Kan tas som frittstående fag i lærerutdanning. / Ingen utover opptakskravet til Master grunnskolelærerutdanning 5-10.
findings.description: The `prerequisites` row almost always captures generic admission/study-right/'frittstående fag' boilerplate rather than subject-matter entry requirements. The codebook explicitly says to EXCLUDE admission and study-right boilerplate from prerequisites; these rows should be empty (no real forkunnskaper) instead of carrying admin text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Selector/heading map maps a Nord 'opptak/forkunnskaper/adgangsbegrensning' field directly to prerequisites without filtering admin boilerplate.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop prerequisites content matching admin patterns: 'Ingen utover opptakskravet', 'Opptak til ...', 'Kan tas som frittstående fag', 'Emnet er forbeholdt studenter ...', 'Forbeholdt studenter på ...', 'Valgbart/Valgfritt/Obligatorisk(t) emne'. Keep only subject-matter forkunnskap statements (e.g. 'Gjennomført NOR1003', 'Matematikk 1, 2 og 3', 'Bestått 90 stp.').

findings.evidence: Plan: 'Matematikk 1, 2 og 3' then 'Forkunnskapskrav: Bestått 90 stp. i masterfaget.' — extractor captured only the second line.
findings.description: Where a real subject-matter prerequisite IS present, the extractor sometimes captures only part of it and drops a sibling line. In MAT5006 the plan lists 'Matematikk 1, 2 og 3' as prior courses immediately above the captured 'Forkunnskapskrav' line, but only the latter was extracted. This loses genuine prerequisite content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The prerequisites field is sourced from a single labelled element; an unlabelled prior-course line sitting just outside that element is not picked up.
findings.suggested_fix: When building prerequisites, include adjacent non-boilerplate lines preceding the 'Forkunnskapskrav'/'forkunnskaper' field that name courses or required prior knowledge (heuristic: lines naming a subject + level with no admin keyword).

findings.evidence: ... På bakgrunn av Covid-19 epidemien ... Midlertidig forskrift ... jmf § 2, Vurderingsformer ledd 1-3 / Å generere besvarelse ved hjelp av ChatGPT ... er å regne som fusk.
findings.description: The assessment row frequently ends with non-assessment boilerplate: Covid-19 temporary-regulation paragraphs (Midlertidig forskrift ... ledd 1-3/1-4), ChatGPT/fusk warnings, and exam-aids lines ('Alle hjelpemidler', 'Blyant, penn, linjal ...'). The codebook says to keep only assessment design and strip administrative blurb; these tails should be dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The assessment block boundary extends to the next real heading and absorbs trailing admin sentences (fusk warning, Covid forskrift) and the exam-aids field that visually follow it.
findings.suggested_fix: Trim assessment trailing lines matching: 'Å generere besvarelse ved hjelp av ChatGPT', 'Covid-19 epidemien', 'Midlertidig forskrift', 'jmf § 2, Vurderingsformer', and exam-aid-only lines ('Alle hjelpemidler', 'Alle hjelpemiddel', 'Ingen ut over de som angis i eksamensoppgaven', 'Blyant, penn, linjal ...').

findings.evidence: ... Fleire arbeidsoppgåver er definerte som arbeidskrav som må vere godkjende før ein får lov til å gå opp til eksamen, andre går inn i mappevurderinga til eksamen ...
findings.description: REL1005's teaching_methods row absorbs paragraphs describing arbeidskrav and exam-gating ('arbeidskrav som må vere godkjende før ... eksamen'). Per the codebook teaching_methods must exclude mandatory work that gates the exam (coursework_requirements) and anything graded (assessment); this content is mislabelled.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Nord's 'Undervisnings- og arbeidsformer' block runs into an arbeidskrav-description paragraph; the splitter keeps it under teaching_methods instead of routing the arbeidskrav prose to coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: Within the teaching_methods block, split off paragraphs containing 'arbeidskrav', 'må vere/være godkjen(de/t) før ... eksamen' into coursework_requirements; keep only undervisnings-/arbeidsform prose in teaching_methods.

findings.description: REL1005 emits a prerequisites row whose entire content is the placeholder '...' (an ellipsis standing in for an empty/forbeholdt field). A placeholder should not be emitted as a section row.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: An empty or '...' source field is passed through to prerequisites without an emptiness check.
findings.suggested_fix: Drop section rows whose trimmed content is a placeholder ('...', '-', 'Ingen.', empty) so they are treated as absent.

findings.evidence: Plan opens with 'Masteroppgaven skal være et selvstendig vitenskapelig arbeid ...'; course_content begins at the second paragraph 'Masteroppgaven utgjør et skriftlig oppgave ...'.
findings.description: For MAT5006 the first content paragraph ('Masteroppgaven skal være et selvstendig vitenskapelig arbeid ...') is omitted and course_content starts only at the second paragraph. A leading content paragraph is dropped, so course_content is incomplete relative to the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The course_content field is sourced from one element while a preceding intro paragraph lives in a separate (possibly 'Mål'-labelled) element that is not merged into content.
findings.suggested_fix: Merge the intro/'Mål og innhold' content paragraph into course_content when it precedes the main innhold block and is content-describing (not a learning-outcome statement).

findings.evidence: Source only ever states 'Semesteravgift og pensumlitteratur.' (a cost note), never an itemised syllabus.
findings.description: No reading_list section is ever emitted. In this sample that is largely CORRECT absence — Nord plans contain only a cost note ('Semesteravgift og pensumlitteratur') rather than an itemised pensum — so this is a no-content situation, not a dropped section. Flagged at low severity only to record that Nord plans carry no extractable reading list in the source.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source does not expose syllabus/pensum content; nothing to extract.
findings.suggested_fix: No action needed for reading_list; do not map the 'Semesteravgift og pensumlitteratur' cost note to reading_list (it is admin boilerplate).
